card.subject: A pre-push from any linked worktree flips the shared repo to core.bare=true: a unit test runs git init with the hook's GIT_DIR inherited
card.activeForm: Isolating the unit suite's git calls from the hook environment

origin.evidence: cd /tmp && git init -q r && git -C r commit -q --allow-empty -m x && git -C r worktree add -q ../w -b w && GIT_DIR=/tmp/r/.git/worktrees/w git init -q /tmp/o && git config --file /tmp/r/.git/config core.bare  # prints true

work_items: Card #21: stop unit tests inheriting GIT_* from the hook environment
runConfiguration.backwards_compatibility: none. The change touches only the unit-test harness; nothing that ships changes.
runConfiguration.security_tier: S1. The fix makes the pre-push security test hermetic; no security code changes.
runConfiguration.operational_rigour: standard. The regression test is shown red with the fixture disabled; a real pre-push is exercised from a scratch linked worktree, never from this repo's worktree. No preprod verification: nothing changed is observable there.

card.description: Measured by card #17 on 2026-10-14. git 2.43.0 exports GIT_DIR=<repo>/.git/worktrees/<name> to a pre-push hook run from a linked worktree (shown with a scratch pre-push hook printing $GIT_DIR). The pre-push stage in .pre-commit-config.yaml runs pytest tests/unit. tests/unit/scripts/test_check_security_alerts.py:415 (test_scan_copies_reads_tracked_files_through_git) runs git init -q <tmp_path root> with the environment inherited; with a linked worktree's GIT_DIR, git re-initialises that repository and writes core.bare = true into the shared .git/config (with a plain repository's GIT_DIR it does not). The test's following git -C <root> add then runs against the real repository and fails, so the push is refused, and every git command in the root checkout and every card worktree fails with 'fatal: this operation must be run in a work tree' until core.bare is set back. It happened twice in card #17's pushes, at 17:52:35 and 18:14:45 local. The root checkout is unaffected as a pusher because its hook gets GIT_DIR=.git. The module under test also shells out to git ls-files, which inherits the same GIT_DIR. Only this unit test invokes git today (grep -rln subprocess tests/unit | xargs grep -ln git). Likely fix: an autouse fixture in tests/unit/conftest.py that deletes every GIT_* variable, plus a regression test that runs the git-invoking test with GIT_DIR set to a scratch linked worktree's gitdir and asserts that repository's core.bare stays false. The land gate's make test-unit runs in the card worktree; whether git exports GIT_DIR there is unmeasured.

status.summary: An autouse fixture in tests/unit/conftest.py (isolate_from_git_hook_environment) deletes every GIT_* variable before each unit test, so a pre-push hook's GIT_DIR from a linked worktree no longer reaches the security-alerts test's git init or the module's git ls-files. tests/unit/test_git_hook_environment.py reproduces the hook environment against a scratch repository and linked worktree and asserts core.bare stays false; with the fixture disabled it fails on assert 'true' == 'false'. End to end, a real push from a scratch clone's linked worktree passed every pre-push hook and left core.bare false; the same push with the fixture disabled was refused (1 failed, 2044 passed) and set core.bare true, reproducing card 17's incident in scratch. The real repository read core.bare=false throughout. The land gate receives no GIT_DIR from git: hydrostat starts it with its own environment minus FILTER, BENCH_MIN_SUITES and ONLY. All three land-gate commands pass in this worktree: terraform init, make validate (8 of 8 blocking stages) and make test-unit (4260 passed). Spec: specs/1406-hook-git-env-isolation/spec.md.
for_the_board: Remove #21 from cards/goal.json: priority item 2 and the READY list.

The hazard is gone only for branches that contain this landing. The pre-push hook runs the pushing worktree's own tests/unit/conftest.py, so a card worktree cut before the landing still flips core.bare=true on a push. Lift the 'push only from the root checkout' rule for a worktree only after its branch is rebased onto main past this landing.
A push from a card worktree is still refused by check-branch-collision (#22), which is now the next blocker for Dynamos that need CI.

Improve drops filed this run: 3 global (a reboot wipes /tmp scratch; pre-commit's pre-push runs nothing for a push with no new commit; the host hook refuses the hook-skipping git flag even inside quoted text) and 2 local (card worktrees have no .venv; make validate fails lint until terraform init -backend=false runs).

After landing, remove the scratch evidence dir ~/.cache/card21-e2e (a bare remote, a clone with a linked worktree, and the push, validate and test-unit logs). Nothing in it is cited by path from a committed file.
